**France: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 3,129,453 applications. The largest annual volume was 218,948 in 2024; 2025 recorded 214,228. Applications in 2025 were 12% higher than in 2019 (191,825). In 2025, 209,584 recorded decisions equated to 98 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 2.2% lower than in 2024 (218,948). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 2 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Dem. Rep. of the Congo (19,510), Afghanistan (18,415), Guinea (15,519).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 37%, across 206,819 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 1.3% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 3.2 percentage points higher than in 2024 (34%).
